description.content:
Returns notes and attachments associated with the specified work order. Notes are sorted in descending order by creation date.
Learn more about work order notes in [SCU](https://servicechannel.atlassian.net/wiki/x/4oPNKQ).

query.description:
Page numbering to display work order notes.
             • The format is **Page number:Page size**, for example, **1:10**, meaning the 1st page with 10 notes displayed. To view the second page, change the entry to **2:10**.
             • When the field is left empty, you get 10 notes per page with the latest note at the top.
             • To get all WO notes, ensure you specify a large number as the **Page size** that will cover all the notes, for example, **1:9999**.

Returns work order notes and attachments for the specified WO ID.
Supports filtering and sorting within the response.  • **$expand:** Expand a navigation property. For example, enter **`attachments`**. To include specific fields for the expanded property, combine with the **`$select`** query option, for example, **`attachments($select=Id,Name)`**.  • **$select:** Select a set of properties to return. For example, **`Id,NoteData,CompanyName,CreatedBy`**.  • **$filter:** Filter notes by the specified property in the response. For example, **`NoteType eq 'UsersNote'`**.  • **$orderby:** Order notes by the specified property in the response — in ascending **`asc`** or descending **`desc`** order. For example, **`DateCreated asc`** or **`DateCreated desc`**.  • **$top:** Return the specified number of notes in the response.  • **$skip:** Skip the specified number of notes in the response.  • **$count:** Include the count of the matching notes in the response.
